acceptanceCriteria: a copied-store completion through the upstream path is retained with receipt audit CONSISTENT and the manifest binding tree and gate
a commit absent from both local and upstream refs refuses COMMIT_NOT_INTEGRATED on the copy
before/after ref digests show no ref moved; results recorded in a build-log entry cited by V1-0557
body: Residual from the V1-0557 audit lane (2026-10-16, origin/main f81114713, corvint-tasks build 558). V1-0557 AC2 asks for qualification on representative copied stores; the only evidence is fixture tests (TestCALV0017_CompleteAcceptsAnUpstreamIntegratedCommit, TestCALV0017_CommitNotIntegratedIsIntentOnly) plus ~30 live VERIFIED completions via the upstream path (e.g. V1-1404/1407 at PR #919 merge tree f89a6be0, local main not containing it). Expected: a retained run on a copy of .git/taskman plus refs: claim, submit and gate at a merge commit reachable only from refs/remotes/origin/main, complete, then receipt audit CONSISTENT, manifest binds candidate tree and gate, no ref moved; and a commit absent from both refs refuses STALE_TREE + COMMIT_NOT_INTEGRATED.
title: Qualify complete upstream reachability (CAL-V0-017, V1-1081) on a copied Corvint store
